label: reported
text: Ministers Salvini and Valditara have reportedly exerted pressure to avoid school cuts, while the EU reminded that treaties forbid discrimination against foreign students. Additionally, protests demanded increased government investment in education and warned that staff reductions will lower teaching quality.

sources.title: Angela Verdecchia: “Il governo investa di più. Noi studenti in piazza anche per i professori” - la Repubblica
